Tim’s voice rang out loud but not too loud and nervously, “Uh, Guys..” but his voice was muted between the sounds of screams, agony, sobs and useless chatter from civilians. Tim continued to nervously look for damian, moving around quickly as he pushed people out of the way. Where was he? Last time he saw damian, he was gravely injured but now he can’t find him. Where—where is his brother? Why can’t he find him? What if he was taken? no, that didn’t happen. Tim forced himself to breathe in and out once, he then continued. Stephanie and Duke noticed how panicked Tim seemed, sharing a look. Tim then spoke again, louder and noticeably more nervous than the last time. “Guys! Guys, guys guys . . I can’t—i can’t find damian. Last time I saw him, he—he was injured. Like, badly.” Tim said, his eyes searching the roads and rooftops desperately.

entry.title: Blood Is Thicker Than Water
entry.summary:
Author: bajuwa

Rating: ExplicitLanguage: EnglishWords: 3,640Chapters: 1/?Kudos: 12

Summary: The blood of the bond is thicker than the water of the womb. It's a phrase Bruce knows all too well. It's used by werebeasts of all kinds to justify their perverse attempts at “making a family of their own” while not caring for the damage they leave in their wake. Mothers and fathers weep for their stolen children. Brothers and sisters beg for their sibling’s return. Their words fall on deaf ears, for the call of the pack is louder than the cries of the family. Bruce Wayne, orphaned child of a vampire attack, refuses to taint his own growing family with such marks of servitude. Batman, Gotham's own covenless vampire, will accept no such tragedies in his territory. So when a rogue werewolf shows up in his very backyard amidst waves of bitten bodies and missing persons, he does as he always does: He protects Gotham. He protects his family. No matter the cost.
